title: STEREODISCO: Discovering Stereotypicality in LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on proposing a framework to discover and quantify stereotypes in large language models using semantic axes. Although one aspect of the stereotype content model includes 'morality' as a sub-dimension of 'warmth', the primary focus of the work is identifying social bias and stereotypical representations regarding social groups rather than specifically evaluating ethics, morals, or religious reasoning in LLMs.
